summary: Isolate proxy test client waiting from application deadlines

delivery.outcome: Resolve GitHub issue137: separate bounded test-client socket waiting from the production request deadline and demonstrate both with controlled loopback transport. Publish only through independent OneDev/Validator.
nonGoals: No production deadline, archive, adaptive selector, provider, credential or release changes.

architecture.decision: Give the internal test HTTP helper a configurable finite socket timeout with30s default. A controlled mock backend blocks on an event so a short client wait deterministically expires; a longer wait succeeds while the payload request timeout remains unchanged. Existing adaptive/model/structured-output assertions and separate persistence integrations remain.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of test harness changes.

validation.evidence: Controlled delayed loopback response, payload timeout preservation, existing proxy regressions and exact-head independent delivery.
